_readme: Local catalogue used while Shopify is not connected (preview mode). Edit this file to change text, colourways or images without touching components. Prices are intentionally null: no retail price has been approved. All images are AI-generated concept references from the DAMI Sample Order Brief v1 / Master Tech Pack v2 — replace with approved photography when available.

collections.name: Confirmed
collections.description: A study in signature. Deep Bordeaux marks on bone, a red wordmark on black, and the DAMI hand embroidered along both forearms — the collection that puts the label's handwriting on the garment.
collections.imageAlt: Concept reference: bone hoodie seen from the back with five Bordeaux lipstick marks

collections.name: Essentials
collections.description: Quiet pieces with a French vocabulary. One word on the chest, a Roman numeral and two drawn curves on the back — essentials built around restraint, colour and line.
collections.imageAlt: Concept reference: Bordeaux hoodie with DÉSIR on the chest

collections.name: I Edition
collections.description: The first piece designed around an engineered pattern: curved panels, rib inserts and a woven I tab at the hood. Form is the decoration.
collections.imageAlt: Concept reference: bone hoodie with curved sculpted panel seams

sharedDetails.materials: Development target: three-end brushed-back fleece with a smooth matte face and a soft brushed interior, approximately 340 GSM (330–350 GSM trial range). 2×2 rib cuffs and hem. Final fibre composition will be confirmed by mill verification and printed on the care label — it is not stated here until verified.
sharedDetails.fit: Unisex, boxy and slightly shorter in the body — not cropped. Dropped shoulders and relaxed, gently tapered sleeves. Final measurements will be published once physical size samples are approved.
sharedDetails.construction: Structured double-layer hood with no drawcords or eyelets. Self-fabric kangaroo pocket with reinforced corners. DAMI signature machine-embroidered on both outer forearms; graphics in soft-hand matte screen print. These are development targets pending pre-production sample approval.
sharedDetails.care: Care instructions will be confirmed after wash testing on the approved sample and printed on the garment label.
sharedDetails.shipping: Shipping destinations, rates and delivery times will be published at launch.
sharedDetails.returns: Return and exchange conditions will be published at launch, in line with consumer law in each destination.
